#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Consolidated cross-check driver: random FIBs vs brute-force reference."""
import os, random, subprocess, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/work/tmp')
import gen as G
import ref as R

BIN = '/work/submit/planb64'
T = '/work/tmp/w'
os.makedirs(T, exist_ok=True)
fails = 0
cases = 0

def run(args):
    return subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True)

def check(seed, nfib, ntrace):
    global fails, cases
    cases += 1
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    fibp = T + '/f%d.txt' % seed; trp = T + '/tr%d.txt' % seed; img = T + '/i%d.idx' % seed
    G.gen_fib(fibp, nfib, rng)
    fx = R.parse_fib(fibp)
    G.gen_trace(trp, [(s, ln) for (s, ln, h) in fx], ntrace, rng)
    p = run([BIN, 'build', fibp, img])
    if p.returncode != 0 or p.stderr:
        print("BUILD FAIL", seed, nfib, p.returncode, p.stderr.decode()); fails += 1; return
    want = R.serialize(R.compile_rows(fx))
    got = open(img).read()
    if got != want:
        print("IDX DIFF", seed, nfib); fails += 1
        ga, wa = got.splitlines(), want.splitlines()
        if ga[:2] != wa[:2]: print("  header", ga[:2], wa[:2])
        for i in range(2, min(len(ga), len(wa))):
            if ga[i] != wa[i]:
                print("  row", i, "got", ga[i], "want", wa[i]); break
        return
    keys = []
    for line in open(trp).read().split('\n'):
        toks = [t for t in line.replace('\t',' ').replace('\r',' ').split(' ') if t]
        if not toks: continue
        keys.append(R.addr_upper(toks[0]))
    wantout = "".join("%d %d\n" % R.lookup_key(fx, k) for k in keys)
    for mode in ('scalar', 'batch 1', 'batch 7', 'batch 256', 'batch 003'):
        p = run([BIN, 'lookup', img, trp] + mode.split())
        if p.returncode != 0 or p.stderr:
            print("LOOKUP FAIL", mode, seed, nfib, p.returncode, p.stderr.decode()); fails += 1; continue
        if p.stdout.decode() != wantout:
            print("OUT DIFF", mode, seed, nfib); fails += 1
            ga, wa = p.stdout.decode().splitlines(), wantout.splitlines()
            for i in range(min(len(ga), len(wa))):
                if ga[i] != wa[i]: print("  line", i, "got", ga[i], "want", wa[i], "key", hex(keys[i])); break

t0 = time.time()
for seed in range(1, 21):
    for nfib in (0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 9, 17, 40, 90, 200):
        check(seed * 1000 + nfib, nfib, (seed * 3) % 19 + 1)
        if time.time() - t0 > 150: break
    if time.time() - t0 > 150: break
print("cases:", cases, "failures:", fails, "secs %.1f" % (time.time() - t0))
PYEOF
cd /work/tmp && timeout 175 python3 cross.py 2>&1 | tail -15
